; rm-ayah-toolbar: load an Arabic UI font so the keyboard (and Arabic text) has glyphs.
; The font ships in ayah.rcc at qrc:/ayah/fonts/. Loading it as an application font
; makes it available to Qt's fontconfig fallback.

AFFECT /qt/qml/xofm/modules/virtualkeyboard/qml/KeyboardPanel.qml
    TRAVERSE ?#root
        LOCATE AFTER ALL
        INSERT {
            FontLoader {
                id: ayahArabicFont
                source: "qrc:/ayah/fonts/NotoNaskhArabicUI.ttf"
            }
        }
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT
